title: Optimistic Policy Regularization: Elite-Statistic Reward Shaping
abstract: arXiv:2603.06793v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: On-policy agents discard trajectories after each update, including rare high-return episodes. We propose Optimistic Policy Regularization (OPR), which turns those episodes into a closed-form reward bonus: we estimate an elite action prior from top-quartile episodes and add a \reviewblue{bounded transform of the log-ratio} of the prior to the policy's action distribution. OPR needs no auxiliary network, value gate, off-policy correction, or adversarial loop. It is a one-line modification of Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO)'s reward; yet, on 49 Atari games at 10M steps, $5\times$ fewer agent decisions than the 200M-frame baselines, it reaches a 148.4\% median human-normalized score (HNS; 196.9\% interquartile mean): higher scores than published PPO on $36/49$ games ($p{=}0.0014$) and a higher aggregate median than self-imitation learning, which falls well below OPR when frames and backbone are matched. translated_title: 乐观策略正则化：基于精英统计的奖励塑形
translated_abstract: 同策略智能体在每次更新后会丢弃所有轨迹，包括那些罕见的高回报回合。我们提出了乐观策略正则化，将这些回合转化为一种闭式形式的奖励加成：我们从表现最好的四分之一回合中估计一个精英动作先验，并将该先验对数比率的有界变换加到策略的动作分布上。OPR 无需辅助网络、价值门控、离策略校正或对抗循环。它仅是对近端策略优化（PPO）奖励的一行修改；然而，在 49 个 Atari 游戏上以 1000 万步进行测试时——所用智能体决策次数比 2 亿帧基准少 5 倍——它达到了 148.4% 的中位人类归一化得分（HNS；四分位均值达 196.9%）：在 36/49 个游戏上得分高于已发表的 PPO（p=0.0014），且总体中位数高于自我模仿学习——当帧数和骨干网络相匹配时，自我模仿学习的表现远逊于 OPR。我们将该方法与一个理论……（摘要截断）
tldr: 论文提出乐观策略正则化（OPR），将同策略训练中被丢弃的罕见高回报回合转化为基于精英动作先验对数比率的闭式奖励加成，仅需对 PPO 奖励做一行修改，便在 49 个 Atari 游戏上以少 5 倍的决策次数超越了 PPO 和自我模仿学习等基线。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Optimistic Policy Regularization (OPR), which converts rare high-return on-policy episodes that would otherwise be discarded into a closed-form reward bonus derived from an elite action prior's log-ratio, achieving higher performance than PPO and self-imitation learning on 49 Atari games with only a one-line reward modification and 5× fewer agent decisions.
